plan.summary: BRO-5265: 15 show dirs had mutual crossOutletDuplicate 2-cycles (each file named the other as its primary), so both copies were excluded and the review vanished. Clear the flag on the adjudicated keeper of each pair; the other copy stays flagged against it. Part 1 of 2 (an-act-of-god-2016, beautiful-the-carole-king-musical-2014, escape-to-margaritaville-2018, ghost-the-musical-2012, harry-potter-2021, in-transit-2016, jitney-2017, king-charles-iii-2015).
steps: Per pair: write a crossOutletClearReason breadcrumb on the keeper.
Per pair: clear crossOutletDuplicate on the keeper.
